notes.text: אס״ר פ״ה״ג is expanded as Esther Rabbah 5:3 from the connected citation; no named edition is independently verified.
Shilka is a conventional vocalization of שילקא, listed in Hanina bar Shilka. The abbreviated title remains R'.
